title: Chapter prototype
question: A short linear chapter: ability triggers resonance, tuned movement. Orbs grant red (dash), green (double jump), yellow (stomp), blue (swing) one at a time; unacquired colors stay gray. Gentle main route, with a few harder side rooms (marked with an orange diamond exit) that loop back in. Does a full chapter, not just a single room, feel good?

title: Wall jump trial
question: The tuned controller with wall slide + wall jump turned on. Does Violet wall-jump in round 3, or does round 2 settle it: no?
extra_controls: Hold toward a wall while falling: wall slide
Jump while touching a wall: wall jump

title: Movement feel
question: Does this feel right as the baseline? Tab compares with the bake-off's movement; F1 tunes it live.

title: Ability triggers resonance
question: The 2019 design: using an ability makes its color resonate for 1.5s. Does a dash into a red wall read as 'passing through', not a glitch?

title: Choose your color
question: The bake-off design: Q switches a persistent active color, and only its ability works. Is losing the other ability while red is selected annoying or fine?

title: Hold to resonate
question: A third option: abilities always work; hold E to resonate (Q picks the color), limited by a breath meter. Does metering the 'pass through' moment feel better or worse than the other two?

title: Yellow stomp
question: Is stomping through weak floors fun enough to be a color's whole ability?

title: Blue as teleport
question: Blue was undecided in 2019 between swinging and teleporting. L blinks a short distance, through walls. Does it feel different enough from dash?

title: Blue as swing
question: Hold L near a blue ring to swing. Does swinging add a kind of movement the other colors don't have?

title: Your 2019 example puzzle (ability triggers resonance)
question: "shift to green to double jump over a high wall, then shift to red to dash mid-air through a red wall/opening, and finally shift to yellow before landing to stomp through a weak wooden floor." Does it work as a moment?

title: Your 2019 example puzzle (choose your color)
question: "shift to green to double jump over a high wall, then shift to red to dash mid-air through a red wall/opening, and finally shift to yellow before landing to stomp through a weak wooden floor." Does it work as a moment? Q switches color.
